item.name: Cashier (BFF)
item.activity: Cashier is one to the two jobs available at the BFF supermarket, the other job being the Stocker job. In this job, players scan NPCs’ groceries. It is also one of fourteen jobs available in Welcome to Bloxburg.
item.payNote: Pay varies with total work experience, efficiency, and mood.
item.cardSummary: Cashier (BFF) is an active job at Bloxburg Fresh Food.

item.name: Delivery Person
item.activity: Delivery Person is one to the two jobs available at Pizza Planet, the other job being the Pizza Baker job. In this job, players deliver pizzas to NPCs. It is also one of fourteen jobs available in Welcome to Bloxburg.
item.payNote: Pay varies with total work experience, efficiency, and mood.
item.cardSummary: Delivery Person is an active job at Pizza Planet.

item.name: Fast Food Worker
item.activity: Fast Food Worker is a job that is available at Blox Burgers. In this job, players perform various tasks in the kitchen and at the counter. It is also one of fourteen jobs available in Welcome to Bloxburg. Working as a Fast Food Worker can help a player gain rewards such as commercial restaurant items in Build Mode, Money, and Blockbux. This job replaced the Cashier job at Bloxy Burgers in Version 0.11.9.
item.payNote: Pay varies with total work experience, efficiency, and mood.
item.cardSummary: Fast Food Worker is an active job at Blox Burgers.

item.name: Fisherman
item.activity: Fisherman is a job available at The Fishing Hut. In this job, players catch fish for money. It is also one of fourteen jobs available in Welcome to Bloxburg.
item.payNote: Pay varies with total work experience, efficiency, and mood.
item.cardSummary: Fisherman is an active job at The Fishing Hut.

item.name: Hairdresser
item.activity: Hairdresser is a job available at Stylez Hair Studio. In this job, players act as a hairdresser, and customize the hairstyles of NPCs that come into the studio. It is also one of fourteen jobs available in Welcome to Bloxburg.
item.payNote: Pay varies with total work experience, efficiency, and mood.
item.cardSummary: Hairdresser is an active job at Stylez Hair Studio.

item.name: Janitor
item.activity: Janitor is one of the two jobs available at the Bloxburg High School, the other one being the Teacher job. In this job, players clean up messes and graffiti around the school. It is also one of fourteen jobs available in Welcome to Bloxburg. It was added in Version 0.5.6, along with the Woodcutter job.
item.payNote: Pay varies with total work experience, efficiency, and mood.
item.cardSummary: Janitor is an active job at Bloxburg High School.

item.name: Mechanic
item.activity: Mechanic is a job available at Mike's Motors. In this job, players repair NPCs’ vehicles. It is also one of fourteen jobs available in Welcome to Bloxburg.
item.payNote: Pay varies with total work experience, efficiency, and mood.
item.cardSummary: Mechanic is an active job at Mike's Motors.

item.name: Miner
item.activity: Miner is a job available in the cave at Peak Mountain. In this job, players mine for various ores. It is also one of fourteen jobs available in Welcome to Bloxburg. It was added in Version 0.7.1.
item.payNote: Pay varies with total work experience, efficiency, and mood.
item.cardSummary: Miner is an active job at The Bloxburg Cave.

item.name: Pizza Baker
item.activity: Pizza Baker is one to the two jobs available at Pizza Planet, the other job being the Delivery Person job. In this job, players make pizzas. It is also one of fourteen jobs available in Welcome to Bloxburg.
item.payNote: Pay varies with total work experience, efficiency, and mood.
item.cardSummary: Pizza Baker is an active job at Pizza Planet.

item.name: Seller
item.activity: Seller is a job available at Ben’s Ice Cream. In this job, players serve ice cream to NPCs. It is also one of fourteen jobs available in Welcome to Bloxburg.
item.payNote: Pay varies with total work experience, efficiency, and mood.
item.cardSummary: Seller is an active job at Ben's Ice Cream.

item.name: Stocker
item.activity: Stocker is one of the two jobs available at the BFF supermarket, the other job being the Cashier job. In this job, players restock shelves in the store. It is also one of fourteen jobs available in Welcome to Bloxburg.
item.payNote: Pay varies with total work experience, efficiency, and mood.
item.cardSummary: Stocker is an active job at Bloxburg Fresh Food.

item.name: Woodcutter
item.activity: Woodcutter is a job available at Lovely Lumber. It was added in Version 0.5.6 along with the Janitor job, and is one of fourteen jobs in the game.
item.payNote: Pay varies with total work experience, efficiency, and mood.
item.cardSummary: Woodcutter is an active job at Lovely Lumber.

item.name: Teacher
item.activity: Teacher is a job that is available at Bloxburg High School, which was added in Version 1.2.0. In this job, players perform various tasks in a classroom of NPC students. It is also one of fourteen jobs available in Welcome to Bloxburg. Working as a Teacher can help a player gain rewards such as school-related items in Build Mode, Money, and Blockbux.
item.payNote: Pay varies with total work experience, efficiency, and mood.
item.cardSummary: Teacher is an active job at Bloxburg High School.

item.name: Taxi Driver
item.activity: Taxi Driver is a job that is available at Bloxburg Taxi, which was added in Version 1.6.0. In this job, players pick up and drop off NPC passengers at various locations in Bloxburg. It is also one of fourteen jobs available in Welcome to Bloxburg. Working as a Taxi Driver can help a player gain rewards such as taxi-related items in Build Mode, Money, and Blockbux.
item.payNote: Pay varies with total work experience, efficiency, and mood.
item.cardSummary: Taxi Driver is an active job at Bloxburg Taxi.
